_producer: src/3.rank_papers.py (process_file -> save_json, mutates the BM25/embedding JSON in place and adds global_candidate_ids + per-query 'ranked' arrays under each query)
_producer_notes: Output path is archive/${RUN_DATE}/rank/arxiv_papers_${RUN_DATE}.json. The top-level JSON still wraps the producer's input (top_k / generated_at / papers / queries). New keys added: global_candidate_ids, global_pool_lane_top_k, global_pool_limit, global_pool_guaranteed_per_lane, global_pool_effective_size, reranked_at. Under each queries[i] a 'ranked' array is appended with entries {paper_id, score, star_rating}. 'papers' is {id, source, title, abstract, authors, ...} without a per-paper 'global_score' (score is per-query, kept inside queries[].ranked).
